findings.mechanism: Display labels for Engine-legal verification IDs outside TOKEN are generated as 'verification-' + sha256(canonical(raw))[:16]. Another Engine-legal raw ID can itself equal that generated string, so two distinct verification nodes can render the same visible ID. Status and counts are looked up by the raw verification ID, so the failure-to-green mechanism of the old F-04 is not present: each node still shows its own pass/fail state and counts.

findings.expected_behavior: Visible identifiers should be injective for all Engine-legal IDs (for example, always apply a bijective escape such as percent/hex encoding, or include the node index), without changing the raw-ID matching key. A failure must never be rendered as passed.
